name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) clause adds a requirement that no sentence states. The task's condition ("If you move the ball") attaches only to taking the key. The box is commanded unconditionally by "Then pick up the box", which the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and the Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) clause already cover. Remove the Response clause. Keep RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), Existence(target_picked_up), and Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up), all hard.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is the stated 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' rule, so it stays even though the compiler lists it as redundant. Existence(target_picked_up) is the commanded box pickup after 'Then'. Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) are the required links from the 'if ... also' sentence to the following 'Then' step. All clauses are hard, match the task wording, and add no unstated requirement. Has_door_key is forced through the hard chain, so no Existence(has_door_key) is needed.

texts: If the ball is moved, the key must also be taken at some point.
The agent must pick up the box in the other room.
The box is picked up only after the key has been taken.
If the ball is moved, the box is picked up at that step or later.
